source_backed_context_dimensions.locator: Khmer Orthography Notes, §§Consonant registers and Inherent vowels, lines 235–266; examples table lines 237–243.
source_backed_context_dimensions.profile_scope: Modern Khmer orthographic pronunciation reference; not a balanced contemporary Phnom Penh acoustic experiment.
source_backed_context_dimensions.implementation: Use as four source-attested open-syllable examples only. Do not extrapolate to every sign, coda, or profile.

source_backed_context_dimensions.profile_scope: Descriptive modern Khmer synthesis; no complete contemporary Phnom Penh lexical list or exception inventory.
source_backed_context_dimensions.implementation: Keep as a lexical/contextual dependency. Never overwrite the second base consonant's underlying orthographic class globally.

source_backed_context_dimensions.locator: R12A §§Phonetic syllables, lines 201–209; vowel mapping legend lines 491–496 and individual entries lines 503–615. Huffman 1970, printed pp.6–7 (typical disyllabic stress pattern and explicit Standard-vs-Phnom Penh scope), §VII.A.9, printed p.52 / PDF lines 2216–2225 (U+17C8 stress-marked lexical examples); Chem 2020 Methods, printed pp.104–107 (PDF pp.12–15); Mam et al. 2025 §§2.1–2.3.
source_backed_context_dimensions.profile_scope: General modern Khmer description with explicit colloquial qualification; not a controlled Phnom Penh stress experiment.
source_backed_context_dimensions.implementation: Keep stress, word structure and speech style explicit. Treat schwa reduction and stressed-syllable glottal closure as source-reported context conditions, not automatic spelling-only rules. Do not infer stress from word position alone, do not apply reduction to compounds by default, and do not use the F0-only Mam study as evidence for vowel quality or glottalization. U+17C8 is a spelling cue for the source-described stressed syllable/juncture contexts, not a general stress diacritic to insert or infer in runtime.

source_backed_context_dimensions.locator: R12A §§Nikahit and reahmuk / Coda diacritics, lines 325–331 and 1250–1265; vowel/rhyme mapping entries lines 721–834, especially 777–826.
source_backed_context_dimensions.profile_scope: Specialist descriptive mapping; exact contemporary Phnom Penh token distributions and full coda inventory are not acoustically cross-tabulated.
source_backed_context_dimensions.implementation: Represent the nucleus and coda mark jointly and condition the mapping on the consonant class and, for U+17D0/U+17B6+BANTOC, the velar versus non-velar final distinction. Preserve the source's short-diphthong breve. Do not treat ំ/ះ as independent consonant suffixes, do not extend the pattern beyond the listed environments, and do not promote it to a contemporary Phnom Penh runtime rule without lexical examples and PP validation.

source_backed_context_dimensions.profile_scope: Phnom Penh acoustic sample: 21 speakers screened, four selected speakers (two female), 61 lexical items, three formal-reading repetitions.
source_backed_context_dimensions.implementation: Use as a coda/syllable-context risk flag, not a complete coda-conditioned IPA rule. The paper reports inconsistent duration units/values and does not supply a full vowel × coda × series table.

source_backed_context_dimensions.profile_scope: Four-speaker Phnom Penh sample; article explicitly states Standard Khmer is not a sharply defined variety and notes regional/speaker variation.
source_backed_context_dimensions.implementation: Keep as profile-specific lexical contrasts. Do not implement a global phoneme merger from two examples.

source_backed_context_dimensions.locator: Wayland & Guion 2005, Mon-Khmer Studies 35, pp. 55–82; DOI 10.15144/MKSJ-35.55.
source_backed_context_dimensions.profile_scope: Two male Phnom Penh speakers. The accessible paper summary and Kirby (2014) citation establish the speaker count and acoustic dimensions, but not a verified wordlist size or repetition count.
source_backed_context_dimensions.implementation: Treat as preliminary evidence for a colloquial /CrV/ pathway only. Do not generalize to all consonants, vowel classes or careful speech; do not infer missing sample counts or controls.

source_backed_context_dimensions.locator: Mam, Pittayaporn & Maspong 2025, TAI pp. 138–143; §§2–4, DOI 10.21437/TAI.2025-29.
source_backed_context_dimensions.profile_scope: Five native speakers aged 20–25 from greater Phnom Penh; PPK and SK elicitation. F0 only; no vowel formants, voice quality, or perception test.
source_backed_context_dimensions.implementation: Keep pitch as a separate profile/prosody layer. Do not encode a general lexical tone or derive tone marks from graphemes. The stressed disyllabic r>h examples use a single [r] onset; the authors explicitly request more cluster-onset words to test this context, and no perception test is reported.

source_backed_context_dimensions.locator: Unicode L2/22-290, §§Orthographic Syllable Structure and Coengs, pp. 9–10; R12A §§Phonetic syllables and Unmarked vowel absence, lines 201–215 and 1095–1115.
source_backed_context_dimensions.profile_scope: Orthographic/structural evidence, not acoustic resolution of individual ambiguous words.
source_backed_context_dimensions.implementation: Resolve structure before vowel rules. If lexical segmentation/coda role is ambiguous, keep IPA unresolved rather than guessing.

source_backed_context_dimensions.locator: Kirby 2014, Journal of Phonetics 43, pp. 69–85; production methods/results §§3.1–3.3; perception experiments §§4.1–4.2; synthesis §5. DOI 10.1016/j.wocn.2014.02.001.
source_backed_context_dimensions.profile_scope: 20 Phnom Penh participants; four who consistently retained /r/ were excluded from acoustic analysis. 41 reading items × 3 repetitions and 15 colloquial variants × 3 repetitions; 2,664 tokens recorded, 2,099 obstruent-onset tokens analyzed. Two perception experiments used synthesized continua.
source_backed_context_dimensions.implementation: Keep this as a separate colloquial profile. The observed low-vowel movement is context-specific and F1/F2 was not a reliable perceptual lexical cue; do not turn the acoustic diphthongization into a universal vowel rewrite or tonal mark.

source_backed_context_dimensions.locator: R12A Khmer Orthography Notes, rhyme mapping lines 721–804 and coda summary lines 1250–1265; R12A Khmer Block Notes, U+17C7 REAHMUK examples; Huffman 1970, §VII.A.8, printed p.52 / PDF lines 2189–2215.
source_backed_context_dimensions.profile_scope: Modern Khmer descriptive orthographic-to-rhyme mapping. The page does not identify a balanced contemporary Phnom Penh speaker sample for these exact combinations; IPA is retained as the source's broad transcription.
source_backed_context_dimensions.implementation: Treat each listed sign sequence × consonant class as a distinct source-attested rhyme pattern. Do not generalize to unlisted signs or lexical forms; keep Ukrainian output and runtime promotion unresolved until exact lexical tokens and target-profile evidence are available.

source_backed_context_dimensions.locator: R12A Khmer Orthography Notes, vowel/rhyme mapping lines 777–826; R12A Khmer Block Notes, U+17D0 SAMYOK SANNYA and U+17B6+U+17CB entries; Huffman 1970, §VII.A.1(b), printed pp.47–48, PDF lines 2008–2019.
source_backed_context_dimensions.profile_scope: Specialist modern Khmer spelling/rhyme mapping, with U+17D0 explicitly associated with some Pali/Sanskrit loanwords. Not a Phnom Penh acoustic experiment.
source_backed_context_dimensions.implementation: Keep the velar/non-velar coda distinction explicit for the exact listed ɔ-class patterns. Do not infer the coda from an unresolved orthographic string, do not extend to other vowel signs, and do not turn the mapping into a broad coda-place rewrite.

source_backed_context_dimensions.locator: R12A lines 201–209 and 491–496, with entries lines 503–615; Chem 2020 Methods, printed pp. 104–107 (PDF pp. 12–15); Mam et al. 2025 §§2.1–2.3.
source_backed_context_dimensions.profile_scope: R12A is a descriptive modern Khmer synthesis with colloquial qualifications. Chem is a four-speaker selected PP sample but stress was not modeled. Mam is a five-speaker PPK/SK F0 study; it did not compare vowel quality or stressed vs unstressed vowel realization.
source_backed_context_dimensions.implementation: Require explicit stress, word-boundary and speech-style context before applying these alternations. Keep glottal closure and schwa reduction separate from lexical tone and from vowel-quality rules. No automatic stress assignment or runtime promotion is justified by the current sources.
